Eva usually spends the weekend reading at the park. Eva believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. There are forty desks in our classroom.
Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. At first, Eva found it difficult to keep the habit. The flight was overbooked again.
Little by little, things began to change. Eva prefers snowy weather when running in the park. People around Eva often share different ideas about the school library.
